info.title: dotnet-unused
info.description: High-performance CLI tool for detecting unused code in .NET solutions using Roslyn static analysis. Supports .NET Core, .NET 5+, and .NET Framework projects.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json, or markdown (default: text)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (for JSON or markdown format)

options.name: --skip-usings
options.description: Skip unused using directives analysis (default: false)

options.name: --fail-on-unused
options.description:
Exit with code 2 when any unused code is found (for CI
gating; default: exit 0)

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Treat project load errors as fatal instead of analyzing a
partially loaded solution (default: false)

options.name: --include-virtual
options.description:
Also report unused virtual members (default: false;
virtuals are skipped because polymorphism can hide their uses)

options.name: --ignore-attributes
options.description:
Never flag members with these attributes
(comma-separated)

options.name: --exclude-packages
options.description:
Never flag these NuGet packages as unused
(comma-separated; requires --unused-packages)

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
Explain why each NuGet package was judged used, unused, or
skipped (requires --unused-packages)

options.name: --msbuild-path
options.description:
Directory of the MSBuild to use, e.g. a .NET SDK folder (or
set DOTNET_UNUSED_MSBUILD_PATH)
